title: DcuzaFix
description: This mod fixes the Netherite generation bug in DeceasedCraft's 5.10.16 version
body:
## ⚠️ Disclaimer & Backups (Crucial!)
Because I put this together in just over 30 minutes, **it hasn't been thoroughly tested. There could be potential bugs or instability.** 

**Please make sure to BACK UP YOUR WORLD before installing this mod!** I am not responsible for any corrupted saves.

# DeceasedCraft Netherite Gen Fix (New Dimension)

## About This Mod
While playing multiplayer, I noticed that Netherite wasn't generating at all in the latest version of DeceasedCraft. Since it was ruining our progression, I whipped up this workaround in just over 30 minutes!

### How it works:
Instead of messing with the broken vanilla world generation, **this mod adds a completely new dimension that generates Nether biomes.** You can travel to this new dimension to mine and collect Netherite as intended!

## Features
* Adds a new custom dimension with Nether biomes for Netherite farming.
* Multi-player compatible (Great for servers!).
* Quick workaround made in 30+ minutes.
